items.evidence: README play command on work/ (--ticks 1 --settings k0) printed one JSON object on screen title with every key the brief names (tick, screen, menu_index, volume, difficulty, texts, cursor, piece, stock, grid, slot, slots, clock, speed, coins, served, lost, queue, customers, arrivals, replaying, replay_ready, ledger).
--frame X.png --size 800x480 after runs on title, settings, layout, night, paused, summary, ledger: all PNG image data, 800 x 480 RGBA.
Fresh run: texts [Night Market, Layout, Ledger, Settings, Quit], menu_index 0; up at 0 stays 0, downs go 1,2,3 and stay 3 (Quit).
Settings: Volume: 5 at first, rights go to 10 and stop, lefts go to 0 and stop; Difficulty: Normal -> Hard (stops) -> Normal -> Easy (stops); texts 'Volume: N', 'Difficulty: Normal'; escape -> title.
Run with --settings s1 set volume 3, easy; a second run on s1 started with volume 3, easy; a new folder s1new started with 5, normal.
enter at 0 on fresh place: layout, cursor (0,0), piece stove, slot 1, stock 3/4/2, grid [], texts Layout, Piece: Stove, Slot: 1, Stove: 3, Table: 4, Lamp: 2, plus Enter/Escape lines.
From (0,0): down/left stay; up x4 -> y 4 and stops; right to x 7 and stops; down to y 0 and stops; left -> (6,0). menu_index stayed 0, screen stayed layout throughout.
next_piece x3: table, lamp, stove; prev_piece x3: lamp, table, stove; 'Piece:' text followed each step.
place stove (0,0): stove 3->2; place again on occupied cell: nothing; 4th stove at (3,0) nothing (stock 0); 5th table nothing; 3rd lamp nothing; grid unchanged on each.
erase on empty (2,2) changed nothing; erase stove at (2,0): stove stock 0->1, grid lost it, 'Stove: 1' text; second erase there changed nothing.
escape -> title, enter -> layout with same 3-piece grid and cursor (0,0); a later run on B1 opened layout with the same grid.
next_slot 1,2,3,1,2; save_slot copied grid to slot 1, grid unchanged; load_slot on empty slot 2 changed nothing; after erasing all, load_slot slot 1 restored stove (0,0)+table (1,0), stock 2/3/2.
Later run on B1: slots 1 and 2 as saved, 3 empty; erase then load_slot gave slot 1 grid back.

enter on empty grid and with only a stove: layout stays, texts end with 'Needs a stove and a table' (gone after next word); with stove+table: night, clock 0, speed slow, coins/served/lost 0, grid unchanged, '18:00'.

Night from tick 8: clock 1 at tick 31 (slow 24); fast at 40 -> clock 2 at 44, 3 at 50 (progress kept); stop 50..100 clock 3, screen night; slow -> clock 4 at 123. Pure fast: minute every 6 ticks. '18:0N' and 'Speed: X' texts followed.
Seed 1 arrivals [5,12,18,...,350,356], all gaps 4..10, all <360; same list at clock 0 and 359 and in every seed-1 run; seed 5 and seed 9 gave other lists starting at 5.
Tables (1,3),(2,0),(2,1): customer 1 sat (1,3), 2 at (2,0), 3 at (2,1); one-table layout: later arrivals queued with x,y null; at minute 33 with 3 queued customer 5 turned away, lost 1.
Stove (0,0) table (1,0): customer 1 cooking at 5, eating at 25. Stove (0,0) table (2,0): cooking at 5, eating at 35.
Adjacent layout: at minute 35 coins 8, served 1, table taken by next; with lamp (1,1) next to table (1,0): coins 12 at minute 35.

Hard, stove not next to table: customer 1 left at 35 (lost +1, coins 0), customer 2 seated and cooking at 35 (stove idle at once). Normal: customer 4 left at wait 40 (min 63). Easy: customer 2 left at wait 60 (min 72).
Minute 35 adjacent layout: customer 1 pays and customer 2 from the queue is seated and cooking in the same minute; minute 78 in a 2-stove layout likewise.

Fast night: at tick 2178 clock 360, screen summary, texts Night over, Coins: 40, Served: 4, Lost: 47, Enter: title matching state; 5 customers still present at 359 added no coins or lost; enter -> title.
Same seed/grid/difficulty at fast, slow (summary at tick 8657) and fast/stop/slow/stop/slow/fast mix: all coins 40, served 4, lost 47.

escape at clock 16: paused, texts Paused/Resume/Title, clock stood 50 ticks; enter on Resume and escape both continued from same clock; Title -> title, ledger unchanged, later Replay still played seed-1 arrivals (night given up was seed 3).
After a finished night ledger [{24,3,49,normal}] and Ledger screen 'Coins 24, served 3, lost 49, Normal'; later runs on the place show it; fresh place Ledger screen 'No nights yet'.
Nights normal, hard, easy, normal on LG: ledger after 4th is [24/normal (new), 64/easy, 8/hard], first gone; a replay in between and a given-up night added nothing.
After a night title texts [Night Market, Layout, Replay, Ledger, Settings, Quit], replay_ready true; also in later runs on RF and PZ.

Replay after editing the grid (stove (0,0) removed), Hard and seed 7: screen night, replaying true, 'Replay' text, seed-1 arrivals, summary 'Replay over' 40/4/47 same as the night, ledger unchanged, and the frame draws the kept grid. But the state's grid key during the replay is the edited current grid (no stove at (0,0)), not the night's grid, so the state does not show the same grid as the night had.
After the night: erase a stove, save/load a slot, set Hard, seed 7: Replay still gave arrivals of seed 1 and the same 40/4/47, mid-run counts equal to the original (clock 164: 32/3/16).
Two copies of one kept folder, seed 5, same 1200-tick script: printed states byte-identical (cmp); seed 9 gave other arrivals.
layout.png: grid 8x5 with y up, stoves red at (0,0),(0,2), tables brown at (1,0),(1,2),(2,1), lamp yellow at (2,0), cursor outline at (2,1), texts Piece: Lamp, Slot: 2, stock 1/1/1 matching state.
eat.png/replay.png: grid with pieces, queued grey squares at the left, seated blue, cooking orange, eating green at their tables matching state; Coins, Served, Lost, 18:38, Speed: Fast shown.
title.png '> Ledger' marked; settings.png '> Difficulty: Normal'; ledger.png three lines and '> Back'; paused.png Paused '> Resume' Title; summary.png Night over, Coins, Served, Lost, Enter: title.
README gives keys/how to play, says everything kept is in the --settings FOLDER (work.kp), and the play and --frame commands, which worked as written from my scratch folder.

defects: Quit in a headless run does not end the run there: down x3, enter logged 'quit' at tick 3 but the run printed tick 100 (the --ticks given) rather than stopping at the Quit.
During a replay the reported grid is the current layout, not the replayed night's grid, so the state contradicts the frame and the customers' tables.
The Layout cursor in the state keeps its last layout value during a night (e.g. cursor (1,0) shown in a night); harmless but not reset.
A stray empty button (the hidden ping button) is drawn at the bottom right of every frame (README admits it).

trace.how: context, new, read_again and how far the context grew are the run's own records. written_out a request is its growth less its answers (characters / 4), scaled to the run's exact total; of_which_unseen is that less the visible text (thinking). cost is what the request read and wrote, weighted; carried is what reading again what it added cost at every later request (start.carried: the same for what every request starts from). reading + writing is in_the_ledger
